name: web-ui-playbook
description: Self-contained UI/UX plugin for non-designers: three skills — web-ui-playbook (websites, landing pages, dashboards and forms with a design commitment, tokens first, and a self-audit for contrast, generic-page tells and real browser rendering), brand-color-system (brand palettes with WCAG-checked light/dark tokens) and brand-logo-studio (logos, favicons and brand kits with correct Persian shaping). Tuned for Laravel + Tailwind CSS v4 and Persian/RTL interfaces for users inside Iran (Vazirmatn, Persian digits, ZWNJ, Jalali, Toman, SMS-OTP, Shaparak/eNamad, no foreign CDNs).
